conclusion: Core findings are independent of C1
paragraph: To verify that C1 (path-selection ratio) does not distort our main conclusions, we compute CGA$_{\\text{noC1}}$ = (C2 + C3 + C4 + C5$_{\\text{strict}}$)/4 for all 180 episodes. Model rankings are identical under CGA$_{\\text{noC1}}$ (120B > 27B > 35B > 4B), with Friedman $\\chi^2$=0.9, $p$=0.8303. Spearman $\\rho$=0.366 ($p$=4.3e-07) confirms monotonic agreement. Unsafe-pass counts are unchanged since C1 $\\notin$ HardViol. Conclusion: core findings are independent of c1.
